newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares may rebound after consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares may rebound after consolidation.

text.p: Singapore shares are expected to continue consolidating early this week but could then resume an uptrend as overseas buyers take advantage of undervalued blue chips, dealers said.
On Friday, the key Straits Times Industrials Index (STII) tumbled 11.58 points to end at 2,188.09.
Dealers said the fall reflected a reaction to strong gains in the previous week which took the STII to a high of around 2,220 points.
"Institutions were largely absent at the end of last week," said one dealer. "But the Singapore market is undemanding and should rise again."
